DEC-21 k-of-n pallet_multisig custody for sudo, usdtOwner and all 12 pallet admins; each carries address, threshold and signatories. The contract validates structure only and does NOT bind address to signatories: 2 <= threshold <= n <= 20 (runtime MaxSignatories); signatories unique and strictly ascending by AccountId32 bytes; no signatory equal to its own multisig address or to another role's address in this document; no address or signatory equal to ammAccount, miningPoolAccount, any b"modl" PalletId account or any validators[].account; and no well-known development key as address or signatory, for every purpose. The deny list is the sr25519 and ed25519 public keys of //Alice, //Bob, //Charlie, //Dave, //Eve, //Ferdie, each //stash, //One, //Two and the bare DEV_PHRASE root, plus the ecdsa accounts blake2_256(compressed public key) of the same fifteen URIs. The producer must recompute every address with d9-v2-tools derive_admins, blake2_256(SCALE(b"modlpy/utilisuba", sorted signatories, u16 threshold)), require equality, and project sudo.key, each <pallet>.admin and the asset 1 owner from these addresses; other declared asset owners equal sudo.address (node MainnetAssetOwners). A signatory that is itself a multisig defined outside this document is undetectable here and must be excluded by ceremony evidence. Signatory custody and ceremony evidence remain external.

The contract declares chain network (mainnet|testnet), id, name and chainType (Development|Local|Live; Custom is refused). migration-input requires Live; only migration-input may be labelled mainnet; testnet-labelled migration-input stays valid for rehearsal. id is 1-64 of [a-z0-9_]; name is nonempty printable ASCII (0x20-0x7E) without surrounding whitespace. Mainnet id and name exclude the substrings test/dev/local/rehears/fixture/synthetic (case-insensitive); testnet id and name contain test. The producer must require the bootstrap manifest network and the chain-spec id, name and chainType to equal this declaration, and must reject any bootNodes entry and any telemetryEndpoints value other than null. Label consistency is not proof of which network a spec is deployed to.

bootstrap.assetIds is the complete, strictly ascending V2 pallet-assets ID set and includes every migrated state asset; fresh assets without a migrated book are declared only here. The contract does not model asset definitions or metadata, so the producer must require the ID sets of assets.assets and assets.metadata each to equal assetIds exactly, with no extra or missing IDs, and migrated metadata decimals equal to the state book.
